items: Apple TV: a mini guide while you watch (press down), and Live TV now shows what's on now and next across the screen.
Match stats sit on the match cards, and can be turned off in Settings.
Channels that only played sound now switch players by themselves.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
